summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth remains permitted only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: security baseline covers 61 managed sites but fleet-doctor is not OK, has no run, findings, or checks; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS evidence shows no certificates expiring within 30 days, but does not establish complete TLS configuration. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown, with affected control details not fully available here. Exact decision: keep new public exposure, gated-product launches, and security-sensitive releases blocked; retain existing private gates; allow only bounded reversible growth that preserves current consent, disclosures, data handling, and claims boundaries. Do not claim certification, penetration-test coverage, or a clean bill of health. Do not create a duplicate security report; continue the existing security evidence matrix work item.

Continue the existing read-only fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated evidence, unknowns, owners, affected scope, severity, and release implications for access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependencies, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident signals, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach. The candidate legal evidence-bundle proposal should not be retained as a new security item because corresponding evidence work is already active; keep the existing private launch and security gates unchanged.
